info.name: HustleHub API - Part 2
info.description: Full test suite for auth, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, RBAC and admin. Run in order (folders are sequential). Prerequisites: server running over HTTPS and `npm run seed:admin` executed. Self-signed cert: disable SSL verification in Postman or run Newman with --insecure.

exec: pm.test('Password / hash never returned', () => { const u = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); pm.expect(u).to.not.have.property('password'); });

item.name: Register - malformed JSON (400, no parser details leaked)

exec: pm.test('Generic message only', () => { const m = pm.response.json().message; pm.expect(m).to.eql('Malformed JSON in request body'); });

item.name: Login admin - success (requires npm run seed:admin)

exec: pm.test('Same generic message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'));
pm.test('Owned by the authenticated freelancer', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.gig.freelancerName).to.eql('Frankie Freelancer'));

item.name: Create gig - HTML stripped from input (201)

exec: pm.test('No HTML stored', () => { const g = pm.response.json().data.gig; pm.expect(g.title).to.not.include('<'); pm.expect(g.description).to.not.include('<'); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Mass assignment test",
  "description": "Trying to set someone else as owner.",
  "category": "Other",
  "price": 10,
  "freelancerId": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000",
  "active": false
}

exec: pm.test('Owner is still the caller and gig is active', () => { const g = pm.response.json().data.gig; pm.expect(g.freelancerName).to.eql('Frankie Freelancer'); pm.expect(g.active).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Update gig owned by another freelancer (403)
Delete gig owned by another freelancer (403)
Book gig - client (201) creates booking + transaction

exec: pm.test('Booking and transaction created', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.booking.id).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.transaction.bookingId).to.eql(d.booking.id); });

pm.test('Transaction links both users and uses server-side price', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.transaction.clientId).to.eql(d.booking.clientId); pm.expect(d.transaction.freelancerId).to.eql(d.booking.freelancerId); pm.expect(d.transaction.amount).to.eql(550); });

item.name: My bookings - freelancer sees bookings on own gigs (200)
My bookings - other freelancer sees none (200)

exec: pm.test('Income tracked for the correct freelancer', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.totalEarned).to.eql(550); pm.expect(d.bookingCount).to.eql(1); });
